overall: The AG found the Trust violated the Open Meeting Law by posting an insufficiently detailed November 7 notice and approving insufficiently detailed minutes that omitted documents used; the unanticipated insurance topic and minutes approval timing were not violations.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the November 7 notice items 'Inclusionary zoning – Town Planner' and 'Main Street/Cherry Street' lacked enough detail to show the anticipated topics.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Trust violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to post a sufficiently detailed notice for its November 7 meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Trust failed to keep accurate minutes of its November 7 meeting, which offered little more than topic lists.
Complainant alleged the Trust discussed Corner Spot insurance at its November 7 meeting without listing it on the notice.
allegations.key_passage: As the Corner Spot insurance discussion was not reasonably anticipated by the Chair 48 hours in advance of the November 7 meeting, we find that the Trust did not violate the Open Meeting Law by failing to include this topic on the meeting notice.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Trust posted November 7 minutes before approving them.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Trust voted to approve its November 7 meeting minutes at the Trust's next meeting, we find that the Trust timely and properly approved the minutes of its November 7 meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the November 7 minutes failed to list documents used at the meeting, such as the Main Street/Cherry Street renderings.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find the Trust violated the Open Meeting Law by approving meeting minutes which failed to list documents used at the November 7 meeting.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that a similar future violation may be considered evidence of intent to violate.
Amend the November 7 meeting minutes to include sufficient detail about the discussions and a list of all documents used, within 60 days of receipt of the determination.
remedy_passage: We also order the Trust to amend the November 7 meeting minutes to include sufficient detail about the discussions that occurred, as well as a list of all documents used, within 60 days of receipt of this determination.
